data.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/spec-fidelity-check.sh that compares PIL fields to story done-definitions and exits 1 on any mutation, drop, or paraphrase.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/spec-fidelity-check.sh

## Logic
- Input: --pil-json=<path> --story-id=<id> (reads DDs via ticket show)
- For each PIL field that maps to a done-definition category: compare exact text
- Drop detection: PIL field with no matching DD -> exits 1
- Paraphrase detection: Levenshtein distance > threshold or key term absent -> exits 1 (fallback: exact match required)
- Enrichment: DD with no PIL source is permitted -> exits 0
- On success: exits 0; on failure: exits 1 with JSON {type: 'drop|paraphrase|mutation', field, pil_text, dd_text}

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/spec-fidelity-check.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-spec-fidelity-check.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S9/T1)
